flags.name: --tokenizer
flags.help: Path or name of the tokenizer. When using the PyTorch backend, this replaces the default HuggingFace tokenizer.

flags.name: --custom_tokenizer
flags.help: Custom tokenizer type: alias (e.g., ‘deepseek_v32’) or Python import path (e.g., ‘tensorrt_llm.tokenizer.deepseek_v32.DeepseekV32Tokenizer’).

flags.name: --post_processor_hook
flags.help: Python import path of a user post-processing hook applied after detokenization and before the per-endpoint response formatter (e.g. ‘my_pkg.guardrail.MyPostProcessorHook’). The class must be importable and picklable, take no constructor arguments, and be callable as ‘__call__(chunk) -> verdict’ (see tensorrt_llm.executor.postprocessor_hook). It runs once per output, per streaming chunk, and may rewrite, suppress, or terminate the output; it owns its own per-request state.

flags.name: --host
flags.help: Hostname of the server.

flags.name: --port
flags.help: Port of the server.

flags.name: --backend
flags.help: The backend to use to serve the model. Default is pytorch backend. Options: pytorch

flags.name: --generation-config
flags.help: Sampling defaults source. ‘auto’ loads supported values from the model’s generation_config.json; ‘trtllm’ uses TRT-LLM defaults. Options: auto | trtllm

flags.name: --custom_module_dirs
flags.help: Paths to custom module directories to import.

flags.name: --log_level
flags.help: The logging level. Options: internal_error | error | warning | info | verbose | debug | trace

flags.name: --max_beam_width
flags.help: Maximum number of beams for beam search decoding.

flags.name: --max_batch_size
flags.help: Maximum number of requests that the engine can schedule.

flags.name: --max_num_tokens
flags.help: Maximum number of batched input tokens after padding is removed in each batch.

flags.name: --max_seq_len
flags.help: Maximum total length of one request, including prompt and outputs. If unspecified, the value is deduced from the model config.

flags.name: --tensor_parallel_size
flags.help: Tensor parallelism size.

flags.name: --pipeline_parallel_size
flags.help: Pipeline parallelism size.

flags.name: --context_parallel_size
flags.help: Context parallelism size.

flags.name: --moe_expert_parallel_size
flags.help: expert parallelism size

flags.name: --moe_cluster_parallel_size
flags.help: [Deprecated] Expert cluster parallelism size. This option is no longer supported and will be removed in a future release.

flags.name: --gpus_per_node
flags.default: None, and it will be detected automatically
flags.help: Number of GPUs per node. Default to None, and it will be detected automatically.

flags.name: --free_gpu_memory_fraction
flags.help: Free GPU memory fraction reserved for KV Cache, after allocating model weights and buffers.

flags.name: --kv_cache_dtype
flags.help: KV cache quantization dtype for PyTorch backend. ‘auto’ uses checkpoint/model metadata; explicit values force override. Options: auto | fp8 | nvfp4

flags.name: --num_postprocess_workers
flags.help: Number of workers to postprocess raw responses to comply with OpenAI protocol.

flags.name: --num_serve_frontends
flags.help: Number of HTTP frontend processes serving one executor; values > 1 share the serving port via SO_REUSEPORT (classic IPC executor path only).

flags.name: --num_input_processor_workers
flags.help: Size of the dedicated thread pool that runs the HF input processor (multimodal preprocess) on the chat and completion endpoints.

flags.name: --num_media_load_workers
flags.help: Size of the dedicated thread pool that decodes media payloads (image / video / audio) for multimodal requests.

flags.name: --trust_remote_code
flags.help: Flag for HF transformers.

flags.name: --hf_revision
flags.help: The revision to use for the HuggingFace model (branch name, tag name, or commit id). Prefer –hf_revision over –revision.

flags.name: --config
flags.help: Path to a YAML configuration file. Explicit CLI flags take precedence over values in this file. Can be specified as either –config or –extra_llm_api_options.

flags.name: --reasoning_parser
flags.help: Specify the parser for reasoning models. Use ‘auto’ to automatically select based on the model. Options: auto | minimax_m2_append_think | minimax_m2 | qwen3_5 | qwen3 | deepseek-r1 | deepseek_v4 | poolside_v1 | laguna | minimax_m3 | nano-v3 | nemotron-v3 | gemma4 | kimi_k25 | kimi_k2 | kimi_k3

flags.name: --tool_parser
flags.help: Specify the parser for tool models. Use ‘auto’ to automatically select based on the model. Options: auto | qwen3 | qwen3_coder | kimi_k2 | kimi_k3 | deepseek_v3 | deepseek_v31 | deepseek_v32 | deepseek_v4 | gemma4 | glm4 | glm47 | minimax_m2 | minimax_m3 | poolside_v1

flags.name: --metadata_server_config_file
flags.help: Path to metadata server config file

flags.name: --server_role
flags.help: Server role for disaggregated serving. CONTEXT=prefill (prompt processing), GENERATION=decode (token generation), MM_ENCODER=multimodal encoder, VISUAL_GEN=visual generation. Required when using service registry.

flags.name: --otlp_traces_endpoint
flags.help: Target URL to which OpenTelemetry traces will be sent.

flags.name: --telemetry
flags.help: Enable or disable anonymous usage telemetry collection.

flags.name: --disagg_cluster_uri
flags.help: URI of the disaggregated cluster.

flags.name: --enable_chunked_prefill
flags.help: Enable chunked prefill

flags.name: --enable_attention_dp
flags.help: Enable attention data parallel.

flags.name: --media_io_kwargs
flags.help: Keyword arguments for media I/O as a JSON string. Keys are modality names (“video”, “image”, “audio”) whose values are dicts of keyword arguments forwarded to the corresponding loader. Example: ‘{“video”: {“extract_audio”: true, “num_frames”: 16}}’ to enable audio extraction from video files.

flags.name: --video_pruning_rate
flags.help: Pruning rate for video frames in multimodal models. Applied by Efficient Video Sampling (EVS). None disables EVS, values in [0, 1) enable pruning.

flags.name: --chat_template
flags.help: Specify a custom chat template. Can be a file path or one-liner template string

flags.name: --allow_request_chat_template
flags.help: Allow clients to supply per-request chat_template values. Only enable this for trusted clients.

flags.name: --middleware
flags.help: FastAPI middleware import path to add to the server app. Can be specified multiple times. Each value must point to either a middleware class or an async HTTP middleware function.

flags.name: --grpc
flags.help: Run the selected gRPC protocol instead of the OpenAI HTTP server.

flags.name: --grpc-protocol
flags.help: Protocol used when –grpc is enabled. Options: smg | openengine

flags.name: --served_model_name
flags.help: The model name used in the API. If not specified, the model path is used as the model name. This is useful when the model path is long or when you want to expose a custom name to clients.

flags.name: --enable_visual_gen
flags.help: Enable VisualGen runtime for model checkpoints that support both LLM and Visual Generation. Not required if –visual_gen_args specified or the model supports Visual Generation only.

flags.name: --visual_gen_args
flags.help: Path to a YAML file with VisualGen engine args.

flags.name: --agent_percentage
flags.help: The percentage of agent requests to schedule. Defaults to 0.0. Should be between 0.0 and 1.0.

flags.name: --agent_types
flags.help: Types of agents to schedule. Now Only Support Open Deep Research agent.

flags.name: --report_addr
flags.help: Write the host:port this server actually bound to this file, atomically, once the socket is bound. Lets –port 0 be used and have the launcher read the kernel-assigned port back instead of reserving one up front.
